## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev`
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] No credentials, private data or proprietary datasets are included
- [ ] All commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` line

## Safety and compatibility

Describe effects on data access, permissions, calculations, evidence integrity, tool schemas and existing MCP clients. State “None” where appropriate.
